query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'title',COALESCE(translations->$4->>'title',translations->$5->>'title',title),'kind',kind,'visibility',visibility,'productId',product_id) AS "source!" FROM knowledge_documents WHERE tenant=$1 AND NOT archived AND (product_id=$2 OR product_id IS NULL OR product_id=$3) ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
